title: rabdosia grosseserrata
intro: Rabdosia grosseserrata, commonly known as Himalayan Serrata, is a species of flowering plant in the Lamiaceae family. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever and alleviating pain. The bioactive constituents of Rabdosia grosseserrata include diterpenoids and iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Studies have shown that this plant may also exhibit potential in reducing inflammation and improving cognitive function.
